description: This file defines the AssetFlows static class containing methods and data structures for managing asset creation, retrieval, updating, and querying within a specific orchestration layer of a backend system. It acts as an application layer for asset operations, utilizing repository pattern and logging.

classes.name: AssetFlows
classes.description: Static class providing asset operation workflows such as create, read, update, and query, utilizing repository pattern and logging.

methods.name: CreateAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset using the provided repository, logging the start and end of the operation.

methods.name: GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Fetches an asset by ID excluding soft-deleted assets, with logging.

methods.name: UpdateAssetAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset by ID with provided payload, ensuring asset immutability for certain fields, with logging.

methods.name: QueryAssetsAsync
methods.description: Queries assets based on optional filters, returning a list, with logging.
